people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Peniel
people.line: A place where Jacob wrestled with God

translations.web: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
translations.bsb: So Jacob named the place Peniel, saying, “Indeed, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life was spared.”
translations.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
translations.asv: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for, said he, I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
